title: SAGEAgent: A Self-Evolving Agent for Cost-Aware Modality Acquisition in Multimodal Survival Prediction
summary: Does every cancer patient truly need a complete diagnostic workup for accurate survival prediction? In multimodal clinical oncology, diagnostic modalities follow a clinically mandated order of escalating burden -- from demographics collected at intake to genomic profiling requiring specialized tissue analysis. Current multimodal survival methods either assume all modalities are available or passively handle missing data, but none actively reason about whether acquiring the next modality is justified for a given patient along this ordered workflow. We formulate this as a sequential decision problem and propose SAGEAgent (Sequential Acquisition Guided by Experience), a self-evolving LLM-based clinical agent that decides which diagnostic modalities to acquire for each patient, balancing predictive accuracy against clinical invasiveness. SAGEAgent reasons about each patient's evolving diagnostic state through clinical tools that translate numerical predictions into text, an episodic memory that retrieves similar past cases, and a semantic memory that accumulates reusable decision patterns from experience. Experiments on a glioma cohort combining TCGA-LGG, TCGA-GBM, and BraTS with four diagnostic modalities demonstrate that SAGEAgent achieves competitive survival prediction accuracy while reducing average acquisition burden by 55%.
tldr: SAGEAgent is a self-evolving LLM-based clinical agent that sequentially decides which diagnostic modalities to acquire for each cancer patient, balancing predictive accuracy against clinical invasiveness, achieving a 55% reduction in acquisition burden on a glioma cohort.
tldr_zh: SAGEAgent是一个基于LLM的自我进化临床代理，它依次决定每位癌症患者应获取哪些诊断模态，在预测准确性与临床侵入性之间取得平衡，在胶质瘤队列上实现了55%的获取负担降低。
summary_zh: 每一位癌症患者是否真的需要完整的诊断检查才能实现准确的生存预测？在多模态临床肿瘤学中，诊断方式遵循临床规定的递增负担顺序——从入院时收集的人口统计学数据，到需要专门组织分析的基因组检测。当前的多模态生存方法要么假设所有模态均可用，要么被动处理缺失数据，但没有任何方法能主动推理：沿着这一有序工作流程，对于特定患者而言，获取下一模态是否合理。我们将此问题形式化为一个序贯决策问题，并提出SAGEAgent（经验引导的序贯获取智能体），一种基于大语言模型的自我进化临床智能体，它能决定为每位患者获取哪些诊断模态，在预测准确性与临床侵入性之间取得平衡。SAGEAgent通过以下方式推理每位患者不断演变的诊断状态：将数值预测转化为文本的临床工具、检索相似既往病例的情节记忆，以及从经验中积累可复用决策模式的语义记忆。在结合TCGA-LGG、TCGA-GBM和BraTS四个诊断模态的胶质瘤队列上的实验表明，SAGEAgent在实现具有竞争力的生存预测准确性的同时，将平均获取负担降低了55%。

title: Deceptive Grounding: Entity Attribution Failure in Clinical Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation evaluation checks whether model claims are factually grounded in retrieved documents. It does not check whether retrieved evidence is attributed to the correct entity.
  A clinical RAG response can pass every automated check (zero hallucinations, near-perfect faithfulness, real citations) while presenting drug Y's clinical evidence as evidence about queried drug X. We term this deceptive grounding (DG): a failure invisible to faithfulness, hallucination, and citation checks because every claim is sourced from a real document, about the wrong entity.
  Using a controlled factorial benchmark across 13 models, we find DG rates spanning 8-87% at peak adversarial conditions. Medical and biomedical fine-tuned models reach up to 86.7%; domain specialization amplifies the failure rather than mitigating it.
  A controlled ablation identifies the mechanism: removing entity-specific clinical evidence from retrieved documents eliminates entity-attribution failure entirely, shifting all failures to confabulation. The two failure modes respond to the same trigger, taking different paths.
  Production measurement across 740 drug-disease pairs finds 7.8% overall DG in a deployed RAG system, rising to 13.6% for recently approved drugs. Entity-attribution verification (checking that cited evidence applies to the queried entity) detects DG at 97.0% precision and 98.7% DG recall (IPW-adjusted human gold standard); no existing framework implements it.
tldr: This paper identifies a new failure mode in clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) called deceptive grounding, where model outputs cite correct evidence but for the wrong entity. It demonstrates high failure rates across models, especially in domain-fine-tuned ones, and proposes an entity-attribution verification method that achieves high precision and recall.
tldr_zh: 本文识别了临床检索增强生成（RAG）中的一种新的失败模式——欺骗性基础（deceptive grounding），即模型输出引用正确证据但指向错误实体。研究展示了高失败率（尤其是领域微调模型），并提出了一种实体归因验证方法，实现了高精度和召回率。
summary_zh:
检索增强生成评估仅检查模型声明是否在事实上基于检索到的文档，并不检查检索到的证据是否归因于正确的实体。  
临床RAG响应可以通过所有自动化检查（零幻觉、近乎完美的忠实性、真实引用），同时将药物Y的临床证据呈现为针对查询药物X的证据。我们将此称为欺骗性基础（DG）：一种对忠实性、幻觉和引用检查均不可见的失败，因为每个声明均源自真实文档，但针对的是错误实体。  
通过使用13个模型的控制因子基准测试，我们发现DG率在极端对抗条件下介于8%至87%之间。医学和生物医学微调模型的DG率最高达86.7%；领域专业化不仅未缓解失败，反而加剧了失败。  
控制消融实验揭示了其机制：从检索到的文档中移除特定实体的临床证据完全消除了实体归因失败，将所有失败转变为虚谈。两种失败模式对同一触发因素作出响应，但路径不同。  
在740个药物-疾病对的生产环境测量中，一个已部署的RAG系统总体DG率为7.8%，而针对近期获批药物的DG率升至13.6%。实体归因验证（检查所引用的证据是否适用于查询实体）以97.0%的精确率和98.7%的DG召回率（经IPW调整的人工金标准）检测出DG；现有框架均未实现该验证。

title: Vascular Geometry Characterization for AI-Based Endovascular Navigation
summary: Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) is a time-critical intervention for acute ischemic stroke; however, access remains limited due to a shortage of neuroradiologists and specialized centers. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers potential to automate endovascular navigation and improve accessibility, yet current models lack standardized frameworks to assess navigation difficulty for model training and evaluation. This study aims to identify vascular metrics associated with navigation difficulty and to develop an automated pipeline for quantitative vascular feature extraction, enabling future complexity grading. Vascular trees were segmented from computed tomography angiograms from 61 patients, and vascular metrics including aortic arch type, presence of bovine arch, vessel length, tortuosity, take-off angle, number of reverse curves, were measured using a custom pipeline. A Soft Actor-Critic RL algorithm was used for 120 s autonomous navigation. Outcomes were analyzed using both mixed effects linear and logistic regression. On the left side, the presence of a bovine arch and aortic arch type II/III increased navigation time by 30.19 s and 37.92 s, respectively, while greater tortuosity (\b{eta} = 118.20) further prolonged the procedure and reduced success probability. On the right side, type II/III arches extended procedure time by 45.94 s, while each additional reverse curve was associated with 3.96 s longer navigation time and lower probability of success. These findings demonstrate for the first time that MT agent navigation difficulty is strongly influenced by vascular geometry. The proposed automated pipeline enables objective and quantitative characterization of vascular features, providing a foundation for future development of standardized complexity grading and RL model evaluation, without aiming to demonstrate clinically generalizable autonomous navigation.
tldr: This paper identifies vascular geometry metrics (e.g., aortic arch type, tortuosity) that influence the difficulty of reinforcement-learning-based autonomous endovascular navigation for mechanical thrombectomy, and proposes an automated pipeline for quantitative feature extraction to enable future complexity grading.
tldr_zh: 本文识别出影响基于强化学习的自主血管内导航难度的血管几何指标（如主动脉弓类型、迂曲度），并提出了一个自动量化特征提取流程，为未来复杂度分级提供基础。
summary_zh: 机械血栓切除术（MT）是急性缺血性卒中的时间关键型干预措施；然而，由于神经放射科医生和专科中心的短缺，其可及性仍然受限。强化学习（RL）有望实现血管内导航的自动化并提升可及性，但现有模型缺乏用于模型训练和评估导航难度的标准化框架。本研究旨在识别与导航难度相关的血管度量指标，并开发一种用于定量血管特征提取的自动化流程，为未来复杂程度分级奠定基础。从61例患者的计算机断层扫描血管造影中分割出血管树，并使用定制流程测量了包括主动脉弓类型、牛型主动脉弓存在与否、血管长度、迂曲度、起始角度、反向弯曲数量在内的血管度量指标。采用Soft Actor-Critic RL算法进行120秒自主导航。使用混合效应线性回归和逻辑回归分析结果。在左侧，牛型主动脉弓和II/III型主动脉弓分别使导航时间增加30.19秒和37.92秒，而更大的迂曲度（β=118.20）进一步延长了操作时间并降低了成功概率。在右侧，II/III型弓使操作时间延长45.94秒，而每增加一个反向弯曲与导航时间延长3.96秒及成功概率降低相关。这些发现首次证明，MT代理导航难度受血管几何形态的强烈影响。所提出的自动化流程能够客观定量地表征血管特征，为未来标准化复杂程度分级和RL模型评估的发展奠定基础，但并非旨在证明临床可推广的自主导航。

title: A Personalized Computational Framework for Assessing the Sufficiency of Partially Observed Data in Healthcare AI models
summary: Achieving early and timely diagnosis and treatment for disease is a major challenge. Recent applications of machine learning (ML) algorithms trained on patient data have shown promise in many different settings for predicting the patient health state. A challenge often faced when applying these ML algorithms is that at any given time, not all clinical variables (features) needed as input to perform prediction tasks are available. We define the concept of full-feature-capacity (FFC) to refer to prediction performance when such algorithms make use of all features on which they were trained. We then introduce Feature Sufficiency Analysis (FSA) - an analysis for determining whether a subset of all clinical features needed by an AI model is sufficient to achieve FFC. FSA estimates the underlying distributions of missing variables conditioned on features that are available. FSA provides a patient-specific assessment of whether the existing set of measured features achieves FFC. If yes, then there is no need to acquire further inputs and a ML-based prediction. We provide two case studies: prediction of need for postoperative prolonged ventilation in patients recovering from heart surgery; 10-year mortality prediction in an outpatient cohort. We also demonstrate that FSA also provides a clinically interpretable feature-ranking methodology based on prediction sufficiency, identifies intrinsically hard-to-predict patient populations, and has the potential to perform cost-aware optimization for clinical data acquisition. FSA provides a generic computational approach for determining whether incomplete clinical information is sufficient to support trustworthy AI-assisted clinical decision-making, thereby facilitating the prospective deployment of healthcare AI systems across diverse clinical settings.
tldr: This paper introduces Feature Sufficiency Analysis (FSA), a computational framework to determine whether a subset of available clinical features is sufficient to achieve prediction performance equivalent to using all features, enabling earlier and more efficient AI-based clinical decision-making when data is partially observed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了特征充分性分析（FSA），这是一种计算框架，用于判断可用临床特征的子集是否足以达到使用所有特征时的预测性能，从而在数据部分缺失的情况下实现更早、更高效的基于AI的临床决策。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
实现疾病的早期及时诊断与治疗是一项重大挑战。近期，基于患者数据训练的机器学习算法在多个场景中展现出预测患者健康状态的潜力。应用这些机器学习算法时常面临的一个问题是：在任意给定时间点，并非所有用于执行预测任务所需的临床变量（特征）都具备可用性。我们将此类算法利用其训练时所有特征所达到的预测性能定义为“全特征容量”（FFC）。进而引入“特征充分性分析”（FSA）——一种用于判定人工智能模型所需全部临床特征中的某个子集是否足以实现FFC的分析方法。FSA基于可用特征估计缺失变量的潜在分布，并提供针对特定患者的评估，判断现有测量特征集是否达到FFC。若达到，则无需获取更多输入即可进行基于机器学习的预测。我们提供了两个案例研究：预测心脏手术患者术后是否需要长期通气支持；以及在外周门诊队列中预测10年死亡率。我们还证明，FSA提供了一种基于预测充分性且具有临床可解释性的特征排序方法，能够识别内在难以预测的患者群体，并具有对临床数据采集进行成本感知优化的潜力。FSA提供了一种通用计算方法，用于判定不完整的临床信息是否足以支持可信赖的AI辅助临床决策，从而促进医疗AI系统在不同临床场景中的前瞻性部署。

title: Decoupling Language Guidance from Backbones for Text-Guided Medical Segmentation
summary: Text-guided medical image segmentation leverages clinical semantics to improve lesion delineation, yet many existing models bind cross-modal fusion, supervision, and decoder design into a task-specific architecture. Such tight coupling makes it difficult to reuse language guidance modules across heterogeneous vision and text backbones, and often requires redesigning the network when the encoder pair changes. This paper presents BTHA, a backbone-transferable hierarchical adapter framework for text-guided medical image segmentation. BTHA is built around a stable feature-level interface: given multi-scale visual features and a text representation, it injects semantic guidance through shape-preserving adapters while maintaining the decoder-side tensor contract. To make this interface effective, we introduce a Hierarchical Coarse-to-Fine Supervision Strategy that decomposes learning into global image-text alignment, multi-scale auxiliary localization, and boundary-aware final mask refinement. We further design a Scale-Adaptive Gated Semantic Guidance (SAGSG) adapter, where resolution-specific gates adaptively control textual injection and channel recalibration suppresses redundant cross-modal responses. Evaluations across diverse vision and text backbones show that the same adapter and supervision design remains effective across convolutional and transformer-based visual encoders as well as different language encoders. Experiments on four public datasets further demonstrate that BTHA improves strong text-guided baselines with modest computational overhead.
tldr: This paper introduces BTHA, a backbone-transferable hierarchical adapter framework for text-guided medical image segmentation that decouples language guidance from specific vision and text backbones, enabling reusable cross-modal fusion across diverse encoder pairs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了BTHA，一种用于文本引导的医学图像分割的骨干可迁移分层适配器框架，将语言指导与特定的视觉和文本骨干解耦，使得跨模态融合能够在不同编码器对之间复用。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
文本引导的医学图像分割利用临床语义改善病灶勾勒，然而现有许多模型将跨模态融合、监督机制与解码器设计绑定为特定任务架构。这种紧耦合方式使得语言引导模块难以在不同视觉与文本骨干网络间复用，且编码器对更换时常需重新设计网络。本文提出BTHA——一种面向文本引导医学图像分割的骨干可迁移分层适配器框架。BTHA以稳定的特征级接口为核心：给定多尺度视觉特征与文本表征，通过保持形状的适配器注入语义引导，同时维持解码端张量结构。为使该接口有效，我们引入分层由粗到细监督策略，将学习分解为全局图像-文本对齐、多尺度辅助定位以及边界感知最终掩膜精炼。进一步设计了尺度自适应门控语义引导（SAGSG）适配器，其中分辨率特异性门控自适应控制文本注入，通道重校准抑制冗余跨模态响应。跨多种视觉与文本骨干网络的评估表明，相同适配器与监督设计在基于卷积与Transformer的视觉编码器以及不同语言编码器上均保持有效性。在四个公开数据集上的实验进一步证明，BTHA以适度计算开销提升了强文本引导基线方法。

title: From Classification to Localization and Clinical Validation: Large-Scale Development of a Deep Learning System for Thoracic Disease Detection on Chest Radiographs in Thailand
summary: Chest radiography (CXR) remains the most widely used thoracic imaging modality, yet expert interpretation is constrained by a severe shortage of radiologists in Thailand and across Southeast Asia. Local adaptation of deep learning models to Thai data has been shown to substantially improve accuracy on Thai populations. Here we present the development and comprehensive validation of the chest radiograph analysis model in Inspectra CXR version 5, a deep learning system that performs multi-label thoracic disease classification and weakly supervised lesion localization within a single model. The architecture couples a DenseNet-121 backbone with Attend-and-Compare Modules (ACM) and a Probabilistic Class Activation Map (PCAM) aggregation layer, producing a per-condition classification score and heatmap simultaneously. The model was developed on 874,858 frontal chest radiographs with paired radiologist reports from Siriraj Hospital, Bangkok. On a held-out, radiologist-verified in-domain test set of 19,871 cases, it achieved a mean AUROC of 0.994 (mean sensitivity 92.4%, specificity 98.6%) across nine clinically important conditions. On an independent generalization set of 5,992 cases from 13 hospitals across Thailand, the mean AUROC was 0.970, indicating robust transfer across sites. For localization, evaluated on 4,549 radiologist-annotated cases, the model attained a mean lesion-localization fraction (LLF) of 77.9% at 0.59 non-lesion localizations per image. In a usability evaluation with five thoracic radiologists, the system reached a classification concordance of 93.6%, a localization concordance of 94.7%, and a mean System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 89. These results indicate that a locally developed, localization-capable CXR system can deliver high accuracy, generalize across heterogeneous Thai hospitals, and earn the trust of practicing radiologists.
tldr: This paper presents a deep learning system (Inspectra CXR v5) for thoracic disease classification and lesion localization on chest radiographs, developed on a large Thai hospital dataset and validated across multiple sites, achieving high accuracy and usability scores.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种深度学习系统（Inspectra CXR v5），用于胸片上的胸部疾病分类和病灶定位，基于泰国一家医院的大规模数据集开发，并在多个地点验证，取得了高准确率和可用性评分。
summary_zh: 胸部X线摄影（CXR）仍是最广泛使用的胸部影像学检查手段，然而在泰国及整个东南亚地区，放射科医生的严重短缺制约了专家判读能力。将深度学习模型本地化适配泰国数据已被证明能显著提升其在泰国人群中的准确性。本文介绍Inspectora CXR 5.0版胸部X线分析模型的开发与综合验证——该深度学习系统可在单一模型中实现多标签胸部疾病分类与弱监督病灶定位。其架构将DenseNet-121骨干网络与注意力比较模块（ACM）及概率类激活图（PCAM）聚合层相结合，同时输出每种病变的分类评分与热力图。模型基于曼谷Siriraj医院的874,858张正面胸部X线影像及配对放射科医生报告开发。在由19,871例病例组成的保留放射科医生验证域内测试集上，其对九种临床重要病变的平均AUROC达0.994（平均敏感度92.4%，特异度98.6%）。在来自泰国13家医院的5,992例独立泛化测试集中，平均AUROC为0.970，表明跨机构迁移稳健性。定位性能方面，在4,549例经放射科医生标注的病例上评估，模型在每幅图像0.59个非病灶定位点的条件下，平均病灶定位分数（LLF）达77.9%。在五名胸部放射科医生参与的可操作性评估中，系统分类一致率达93.6%，定位一致率达94.7%，系统可用性量表（SUS）平均得分为89分。上述结果表明，本地开发的具备病灶定位能力的CXR系统可实现高精度、在泰国不同医院间泛化，并赢得执业放射科医生的信任。

title: Super-Generalist: Towards Comprehensive and Accurate Medical Image Understanding via Generalist-Specialist Synergy
summary: Medical images require comprehensive and accurate interpretation to support the diagnosis of diverse clincial conditions. Recent vision-language generalist models offer broad task coverage and promising zero-shot capabilities, yet often lack fine-grained anatomical and lesion awareness for reliable diagnosis and spatial interpretability. In contrast, supervised specialist models achieve strong performance on specific tasks but typically lack generalization across diseases and anatomies. In this work, we present SuG, a Super-Generalist framework that unifies generalist vision-language learning with specialist objectives, enabling both broad generalization and specialist-level diagnostic capability. We perform specialist-enhanced vision-language alignment in SuG by incorporating spatial priors from multiple segmentation experts, including anatomy, class-specific lesion and class-agnostic lesion segmentors that captures lesions beyond anatomies annotated during training. To improve lesion grounding capability, we leverage lesion masks as spatial priors to calibrate text-conditioned visual attention, encouraging disease-related semantics to focus on clinically relevant regions. We evaluate SuG on extensive chest and abdominal CT benchmarks, including CT-RATE, Merlin, MedVL-CT69K, and several in-house tumor datasets. SuG achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of disease diagnosis tasks and surpasses specialist models on several critical tumor diagnosis benchmarks. Furthermore, SuG demonstrates strong lesion grounding capability, including robust generalization to lesion types lacking class-specific supervision.
tldr: This paper proposes SuG, a Super-Generalist framework that unifies generalist vision-language learning with specialist segmentation objectives for comprehensive and accurate medical image understanding, achieving state-of-the-art performance on chest and abdominal CT benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SuG，一个超级通才框架，将通才视觉-语言学习与专家分割目标统一起来，实现全面准确的医学图像理解，在胸部及腹部CT基准测试上达到了最先进性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
医学图像需要全面而准确的解读，以支持多种临床状况的诊断。现有的视觉-语言通才模型虽然覆盖广泛任务并具备有前景的零样本能力，但往往缺乏细粒度的解剖和病灶感知能力，难以实现可靠诊断与空间可解释性。相比之下，有监督的专家模型在特定任务上表现优异，但通常缺乏跨疾病和解剖部位的泛化能力。在本研究中，我们提出了SuG，一个超通才框架，它将通才型的视觉-语言学习与专家目标相统一，同时实现了广泛的泛化能力与专家级别的诊断性能。我们在SuG中通过引入来自多个分割专家的空间先验，实现了专家增强的视觉-语言对齐，这些专家包括解剖分割器、类别特异性病灶分割器以及类别无关的病灶分割器，后者能够捕捉训练中标注解剖结构之外的病灶。为了提升病灶定位能力，我们利用病灶掩膜作为空间先验来校准文本驱动的视觉注意力，促使与疾病相关的语义聚焦于临床相关区域。我们在多个胸部与腹部CT基准数据集上评估了SuG，包括CT-RATE、Merlin、MedVL-CT69K以及若干内部肿瘤数据集。SuG在广泛的疾病诊断任务中达到了最先进的性能，并在多个关键肿瘤诊断基准上超越了专家模型。此外，SuG展现出强大的病灶定位能力，包括对缺乏类别特异性监督的病灶类型的鲁棒泛化能力。
